processes.credit_report_forwarding: Forwarding the periodic credit report from credit staff to the desk contact for use in counterparty risk handling.
processes.trading_book_setup_access: Requesting creation, renaming or access setup of trading books, portfolios and desks in the deal and risk systems.
processes.position_officialization_controls: Calculating, officializing and verifying positions and post IDs (basis/index roll-off, benchmark signoff) and following up on missed steps.
processes.mtm_value_data_request: Collecting mark-to-market values by region for counterparties and returning totals to the requester.
processes.origination_report_support: Pulling and entering origination deal data for the origination file and reports requested by management.
processes.volume_allocation_reconciliation_support: Answering questions and sending files to settle volume, liquidation or billing variances during monthly reconciliation.
processes.daily_report_distribution_request: Asking an analyst to send a copy of a daily report in a shareable format to a named recipient.
